answer: All four made: Layer carried directly in Then::Land; ask_gate, landing_ran and layer_gated return (); stack_on answers Option<Value>; ClearStack/StackCleared deleted, the daemon's start unstacks each stack's bottom layer. 526 scenarios green after.
